scripts.audit:ci: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');let o='';try{o=execSync('npm audit --json',{encoding:'utf8',stdio:['ignore','pipe','pipe']})}catch(e){o=e.stdout||''}const a=JSON.parse(o);for(const[n,v]of Object.entries(a.vulnerabilities||{}))console.log('AUDIT',JSON.stringify({name:n,severity:v.severity,isDirect:v.isDirect,range:v.range,via:(v.via||[]).map(x=>typeof x==='string'?x:{name:x.name,title:x.title,severity:x.severity,range:x.range}),effects:v.effects,fixAvailable:v.fixAvailable}));console.log('AUDIT_META',JSON.stringify(a.metadata&&a.metadata.vulnerabilities||{}));try{console.log('AUDIT_TREE\n'+execSync('npm ls brace-expansion exceljs nanoid next postcss sharp tmp uuid --all',{encoding:'utf8'}))}catch(e){console.log('AUDIT_TREE\n'+(e.stdout||''))}"
scripts.build:core: npm run audit:ci && npm --prefix apps/mba-labs-core run build
